evidence: Adds Cap'n Proto interface definitions, libmultiprocess updates, and multiprocess wrappers for node and wallet.
rationale: This is the foundational multiprocess PR enabling process isolation across node, wallet, and GUI. As described, running GUI, node, and wallet in isolated processes ensures memory corruption or crashes in UI/wallet code cannot compromise consensus validation or crash the node, unblocking subsequent IPC work including #19460 and #19461.
